limitations: All 23 physical pages and all 76 initial claims were re-read and reviewed; initial C file remains unchanged.
Review checks grouped shared primary instruments and data rather than repeating every download. Exact local hashes were independently recomputed for every source in C registry.

The COM proposal and some framework data were accessible through labelled primary web extractions; direct EUR-Lex access could return a bot challenge. These are not represented as original archived PDF bytes.

No participant-level auction transactions, member-company accounts, complete post-reform sales series, tenant agreements or author contact were obtained. Unresolved outcomes are not negative findings.
Five-source document context distinguishes models, forecasts, draft budgets, legal promises and realised observations; no forecast was classified as erroneous merely for uncertainty.
